title: 2_5_Psych_Project_Subject_Owen

question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
Who do you want Owen to date?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do me a solid, $ZOE. Keep dating Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It just means that every second you spend with your handsome, charming, perfect guy...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is a second in which I'm gaining ground for Social Chair!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, come on, Paige, that's enough. Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I'm finally starting to enjoy the cafeteria!
Owen sends $ZOE an apologetic look before he and Paige head towards the cafeteria exit.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What disgusting place are you dragging me to now? A dumpster? A landfill? Some kind of sewage treatment plant?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nope. The weight room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Worse! Why would you ever go to a place where `you're` the person doing all the sweating?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh! Worse! Why would you ever go to a place where [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] the person doing all the sweating?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because I have a sudden need to let off some steam...
Owen has failed.

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Psh. What's it like being jealous of me all the time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, it's okay. You don't have to insult Paige on my behalf. Don't stoop to her level.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, translation, butt out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, before I was so rudely interrupted...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Special? Wait, you think I'm special? Is it this outfit?
As Paige tries to guess Owen's meaning, Owen and $ZOE share a smile.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It could be my shoes. They're imported from Italy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It wasn't your shoes I was referring to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Well... Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... What you want doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!
Owen looks to Spencer, who urges him on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No one cares about being courteous to you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How dare you?! I'm sacrificing `my` time so that `you` can show me what `your` life is like!
nodes.text_bbcode: How dare you?! I'm sacrificing [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] time so that [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] can show me what [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] life is like!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're not going to help me, then I can make your life miserable. Is that what you want?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...
Spencer whispers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stay the course!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't care. You're unimportant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, then.
Paige takes a carton of milk and throws it in Owen's face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm sure you didn't care about that, did you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't `wait` to give my presentation in Mr. Dean's class! I am going to `ruin` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] to give my presentation in Mr. Dean's class! I am going to [color=#3b78e2][i]ruin[/i][/color] you!

nodes.text: Paige storms off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great advice, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Worked like a charm. Now she won't be bothering you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That wasn't my goal!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, well... For the future, that's pretty much how that goes. Like, every time. Only usually with something messier than milk.
Suddenly Paige comes storming back in! She rips a plate of spaghetti off a nearby table and hurls it into Owen's lap!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ruin! You!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ruin! You![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She leaves again before Owen can respond, the spaghetti sauce running down his leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: There it is!
Looks like Owen got what was coming to him! Play again and see if you can avoid a dairy disaster!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Have I ever told you how much I appreciate your honesty?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't argue with me, Owen! I want--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're always really upfront about what you're feeling, and I find that very refreshing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, well... That's... Confusing.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You said you wanted courtesy. Why don't I show you how the cafeteria works?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on... Let's go get a tray.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay... Uh... Thanks.
Owen starts to lead Paige toward the cafeteria line, but Spencer grabs him by the arm as he passes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, you `appreciate her honesty?` What kind of linebacker are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, you [color=#e23b3b][i]appreciate her honesty?[/i][/color] What kind of linebacker are you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A smart one... Sorry, Spencer. But Ben lives in a mansion, and you don't actually know any rich girls.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right... Hmm... Maybe I should start complimenting them...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look... We have to do this assignment together, whether we want to or not. I can't afford to slack on something that makes up fifteen percent of my grade.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well neither can I!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So then, how about I'll observe you today, and you'll observe me next week?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... Or not! I'm studying `you` today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Or not! I'm studying [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] today!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why does the order even matter?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh. You should always get the bad news out of the way first, so you can be cheered up later.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So in your delusional world, my life is the bad news, and yours is the good?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's no delusion, Owen. It's simple. I have more money than you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, when do I have to start participating in your sad little life?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Lunch. Meet me in the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh gross. Cafeterias are like the roach hotels of restaurants. Plus, it's `impossible` to get any table service.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh gross. Cafeterias are like the roach hotels of restaurants. Plus, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]impossible[/i][/color] to get any table service.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just meet me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.
At lunch, Owen sits down at the Center Table and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, I thought `I` missed football. You only played in `one` game, and you're acting like Ben here when Emily left for that trip.
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, I thought [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] missed football. You only played in [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] game, and you're acting like Ben here when Emily left for that trip.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, touchy subject, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My bad, Kale.
Spencer slaps a hand on Owen's back.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, football will be back, man! Is this because we won State? Don't worry! We'll win State again next year!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And the year after that! And the year after that! And the year after `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the year after that! And the year after that! And the year after [color=#e23b3b][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How many years are you planning on being in high school, Spence?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know! Squirrels forever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's not about football, guys. It's this stupid Psychology project for Mr. Dean's class.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige is supposed to observe what my day is like. I can already imagine all the nasty things she's going to say. I just want to get through this project with my skin intact.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why didn't you just take Finances? $ZOE brought in money-themed cupcakes today. Green frosting for the win!
Ben gets $ZOE's attention at the far end of the table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awesome cupcakes today, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben! Hey, can we set aside time soon to get stuff for the Halloween Dance?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For sure!
$ZOE's eyes drift, and for a narrow second, she makes eye contact with Owen...
But the moment passes, and she looks away.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, are you hearing me? Dealing with rich girls is easy. Whatever they say, you just say 'that's not important'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: As soon as Paige gets critical, man up and tell her that her opinion isn't important.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Won't that just make her mad?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, man, `crazy` mad! But she'll come around. In no time she'll be treating you with the respect you deserve!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, man, [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy[/i][/color] mad! But she'll come around. In no time she'll be treating you with the respect you deserve!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That... Sounds like a horrible idea.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Poindexter weighs in... What's your advice?
Spencer adopts a nasally accent.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Gee! Apply nerd formula to vector B and then triangulate the signal! Solve for girls!'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Very funny. Look, take it from me, Owen. If you want to neuter Paige's criticisms, you'll 'kill her with kindness.'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Compliment her. It'll take all the wind out of her. Trust me.
As if on cue, Paige bursts into the cafeteria, her nose crinkled in disgust as she rushes toward the safety of the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe you're forcing me to eat in this jail cell!
Paige sits down and notices Owen's tray.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Where's `my` food?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Where's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] food?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You have to get it yourself. That's how cafeterias work.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no. I'm not doing that. Go get it for me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm not your servant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Forget it. I just wanted some courtesy!
Owen sneaks a glance at Spencer and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ahem. Not important. Cough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kindness!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Go on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's made of money, Mr. Dean. And she reminds me of it every two seconds.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't help being well-off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: See? I'm not like that. I didn't grow up with much.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: And you feel like this will make the assignment difficult?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, people like her aren't supposed to hang out with people like me.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: A very astute observation, Owen.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It's also precisely the reason I've paired you two up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... Switching partners is...?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Not in the cards. Still, I'll give you some leniency on your grade for impressing me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll take it.
Mr. Dean walks away, whistling to himself.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey! Maybe if you bathed more, I wouldn't have to give you so many hygiene tips.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you brush your hair with the same silver spoon you were born with?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Dumb! None of my maids brush my hair with a spoon!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And there was nothing absurd about what you just said, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Enough! Owen, yes, she's mean to you, but you're mean right back, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: So... I've chosen you two because people of different backgrounds can often learn the most from each other.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No thanks. I don't need to know anything more about dressage.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha! That implies that you actually know something to begin with.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: That's it. You're stuck with each other. Deal with it.
Mr. Dean walks away, mumbling something about long hours and low pay.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm actually running late for class, so I think I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bye, Owen.
As Owen walks away, he overhears Howard say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean, I know you and Howard have a history... I just thought, maybe, you know... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh boy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why would you say that, man?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know. I was just trying to... Relieve the tension.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, now this feels even more awkward.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, it's more awkward now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It feels like it gets more awkward every time you guys use the word `awkward.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It feels like it gets more awkward every time you guys use the word [color=#e23b3b][i]awkward.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You just used it `twice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You just used it [color=#e23b3b][i]twice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know. Look, can we just start over or something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think this already feels really weird.
The bell rings for the start of class.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, fine. It's really nice of you to ask!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know how much you care about it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look!
The cheerleaders all stare wide-eyed at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I get it! $ZOE and Howard are amazing together!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's like his words are nice, but his face is mean!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Isn't there something more productive you can do with your time than gossip about other people's lives?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's easy... No. There isn't!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well then do me a favor and shut up about $ZOE and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why are they so special? Why do you insist on talking about them? Why do they matter?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: They matter because all of us wish every day of our lives that we could find something even a little bit as special as what they have, okay?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: They're our symbol of hope.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, and they're really cute together too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but $ZOE and Howard are obnoxious and annoying!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You did `not` just say that.
nodes.text_bbcode: You did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just say that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not cool, bro.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $ZOE is as obnoxious and annoying as you are cool and nice. And in case you can't tell, that means neither of you are any of those things!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: How dare you come into our school and say that, new guy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: New guy? But I helped you win the State Championship!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, with $ZOE's help!
The cheerleaders swarm around Owen, surrounding him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What... What are you doing? I have class to go to.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're not going anywhere until you take it back!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Take it back?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Say that you love $ZOE and Howard together!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? I can't say that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't tell you... I just can't!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: If you want to go to class you will! It's not that hard... After all, they're perfect together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No one's better than $ZOE and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Nooo...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nooo...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Get over it, dawg. You know Howard's the best guy!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And we're not leaving you alone until you say $ZOE and Howard are perfect together!
They crowd inches closer to Owen, backing him up against the lockers.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine! `$ZOE and Howard are perfect together!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE and Howard are perfect together![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen stands there, back against the lockers, gasping for breath.
The cheerleaders smile and move aside, but as Owen walks to class, he feels like he's lost a part of himself...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should have kept my emotions in check...
He steps outside, rounds the corner behind the school for a breather...
And bumps right into $ZOE and Howard mid-makeout session!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!
$ZOE separates from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Awkward!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see `you` there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't seen you much at all since the fundraiser...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Been real busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool.
Owen kicks at a piece of trash on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So...

options.label: How's the Social Chair thing going?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll see what I can find...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Excuse me.
Owen leaves the cheerleaders, relieved that he managed to keep his composure in front of them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right. Excuse me. I'm going to go get some air before I... Before my Psych class starts.
Owen tries to walk away, but Maria pulls him back.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We were thinking... Since you're super cool, and since you and $ZOE are friends and all... Maybe you could get some dirt on how things are between her and Howard for us?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Leave him alone, Maria. It's none of your business.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Of course it's my business. If it happens at this school, I have to know about it. It's practically my job.
Maria turns back to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Besides, even though you're a guy, I know you're just as curious as we are to hear all the juicy details!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's... Disturbing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And crazy romantic! It's just like that movie where that guy loves that girl but then he leaves and then he comes back and he's a zombie but they're `still` in love!
nodes.text_bbcode: And crazy romantic! It's just like that movie where that guy loves that girl but then he leaves and then he comes back and he's a zombie but they're [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] in love!

nodes.text: The girls let out a bunch of `Awww`s all at once.
nodes.text_bbcode: The girls let out a bunch of [b]Awww[/b]s all at once.

nodes.text: Owen brings the weight down and pumps it back up cleanly!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa! You're, like, `strong,` Owen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! You're, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]strong,[/i][/color] Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's so hot!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, for a dumb jock...
Owen finishes the set with ease, putting the weight back on the rack with a light `clank.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen finishes the set with ease, putting the weight back on the rack with a light [b]clank.[/b]

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: After dinner, Owen and Paige talk on the front porch.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma's getting ready for bed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She's... Nice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry about the whole 'us going to the dance' thing. She doesn't really care about boundaries, and I know you and Lee are together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually... That's not true. We're kind of broken up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Serious?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. Turns out when all you do is make out constantly, you don't really get to know the other person.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One of life's great lessons. I think Mr. Dean was lecturing about that the other day.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, I know my life's not like a tour through the Taj Mahal or anything, but, uh, that's pretty much a day in the life of Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was...
Paige trails off, at a loss for words.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Go ahead, say it. It was poor and gross and boring.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not what I was going to say.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. I guess we'll see the opposite next week, right? The rich, clean, fun life of Paige.
Paige's eyes flare for just a moment...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You might not believe this, but I'm kind of looking forward to it. I actually had fun today.
Paige closes her eyes tight, as if summoning some inner strength. They pop open!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you trying to be my friend?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I thought--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what you thought, Owen, but whatever it is, it's wrong!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're not friends, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where is this coming from?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't feel like I've been hiding what I think of your life, have I?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're poor, Owen. Beneath me. And do I need to remind you that you have some silly crush on $ZOE, `my rival` for Social Chair?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're poor, Owen. Beneath me. And do I need to remind you that you have some silly crush on $ZOE, [color=#3b78e2][i]my rival[/i][/color] for Social Chair?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess... I guess I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No kidding. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to get out of your dingy neighborhood and go somewhere `safe.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No kidding. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to get out of your dingy neighborhood and go somewhere [color=#3b78e2][i]safe.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine. See you next week... And not because I want to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.
Paige marches off towards her car and drives off, leaving Owen standing dumbstruck on the porch.
The front door squeaks open, and Grandma Betty pokes her head out.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I heard shouting. What happened, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I don't know. I was trying to tell her that I was excited to see what her life was like for my class project, and she attacked me out of nowhere.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Tsk tsk. It's never out of nowhere, hon.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It isn't? Then what happened?
Grandma Betty rolls her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Boys...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: She's scared, dear. After she saw how nice your life is, she's afraid of something about her own.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? But what does Paige have to be afraid of?
What `does` Paige have to be afraid of? Find out in next week's episode of Surviving High School!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [b]does[/b] Paige have to be afraid of? Find out in next week's episode of Surviving High School!

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 5: Psych Project, Subject: Owen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 2, Episode 5: Psych Project, Subject: Owen![/b]

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, posh! Where is this other girl? Is she here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No... She's... She's dating someone else.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: A story older than me. And what's wrong with Paige? Isn't she beautiful?
Owen catches a delighted look on Paige's face.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... She's beautiful, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You guess. That's the problem with you men, guessing about something that's right in front of your face!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Is she pretty or not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's pretty, okay! I said it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: See, that wasn't so hard now, was it?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, in my day if a girl came over for dinner, it had nothing to do with class!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, Grandma. Times have changed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm not sure who I'm going to go to the dance with.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? What about Lee?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He and I--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You know, I met Harold at a dance! It was the first spring after the war...
As the table is set for dinner, Owen sees Paige starting to eat her soup.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We have a tradition before we begin eating...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Don't worry, dear. You didn't know.
Grandma Betty reaches out her hands to Owen on her left and Paige on her right. They take her hands, and Owen reaches his hand across to Paige.
Paige hesitates for a moment and takes it. Grandma Betty smiles.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I am glad to have food today. I am glad to have my Owie. And I am glad to have his beautiful classmate, Paige, as a guest.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Your turn, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, I'm glad we won State. I'm glad I live with such a cool grandma. And, uh... I'm glad that I got this new start at Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That's very nice. What about you, Paige? Three things you're glad for?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There are so many things to be glad for, I don't even know where to begin!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, sweetie, that's okay. It's your first time, so just take it slow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm glad for... All my shoes, how awesome my life is, and for my horse, William.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Quite a life! Now let's eat!
Owen, Paige, and Grandma Betty begin eating and chatting.
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You get to plan a dance! How wonderful!
Grandma Betty turns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Are you taking this lovely girl to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: It's a perfectly innocent question! You two would make a lovely pair! Besides, how could you not fancy her? She's breathtaking!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma...

options.label: She's just here for a class project.

nodes.text: Paige lowers her voice so only Owen can hear.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So? I don't have to do everything your grandma says.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you're going to. If you didn't care about her opinion, you wouldn't be keeping your voice down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you need me to show you how to do this?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! I can do it!
Paige puts the cutting board down and begins cutting scallions.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just... Don't enjoy this so much!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Very good, dear! Dinner will be ready sooner with your help!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's the assignment.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, it isn't. I just have to try to understand your psyche... That doesn't mean doing everything you do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But Mr. Dean said--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mr. Dean said 'observing, `and to some extent,` participating in.' I draw the line here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Mr. Dean said 'observing, [color=#3b78e2][i]and to some extent,[/i][/color] participating in.' I draw the line here.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're drawing the line at cutting scallions? Why stop there? Why make any effort at all?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tone `not` appreciated. Besides, I want to eat, and if `I'm` not cutting those scallions, I think you'd better get started.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tone [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] appreciated. Besides, I want to eat, and if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] not cutting those scallions, I think you'd better get started.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grrr...
Owen reluctantly cuts up the scallions.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Come on, kids! Chop chop! Soup waits for no man!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...One thing's for sure. You're already starting to get used to me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: As if. How did you come to that ridiculous conclusion?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because you've been in the weight room for thirty minutes, and you haven't made one comment about how gross or vile it is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's just because I've been holding my breath.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I actually smelled anything I'd probably gag or melt or something.
Owen starts heading toward the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... What happens next? Do we perform on the street for tips?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax. I'm just having fun at your expense!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That makes me feel a whole lot better. And to answer your question... We're going to my house... My grandma's house.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You live with your grandma? Wait... What about your parents?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know, Paige. Maybe you don't know `everything` about me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, Paige. Maybe you don't know [color=#e23b3b][i]everything[/i][/color] about me.

nodes.text: An hour later, Owen and Paige step into Owen's grandma's tiny house...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe you live `here.` It's so dumpy.
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you live [color=#3b78e2][i]here.[/i][/color] It's so dumpy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Careful. My grandma might hear you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Hear what, dear?
Grandma Betty shuffles into the living room. She gasps when she sees Paige.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh my oh my! Who is `this` beauty? If she isn't a promising movie starlet, then I'm a retired milkman!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my oh my! Who is [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] beauty? If she isn't a promising movie starlet, then I'm a retired milkman!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma, this is Paige. She's a classmate of mine. Paige, meet my grandma.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hi, I was just saying how, um, `cozy` your home is.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hi, I was just saying how, um, [color=#3b78e2][i]cozy[/i][/color] your home is.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You're too kind, Sweetie! This place isn't much at all. Without Harold, I've made do as best I can.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Harold was my grandpa. He passed a long time ago.
Betty pats Paige's arm.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Treasure what you've got, dear. Now, come on, we've got cooking to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Cooking?!
Grandma Betty takes Paige by the hand and pulls her into the adjoining kitchen. Owen follows.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Could you cut up these scallions for me, Doll?
Grandma Betty hands Paige a knife and a cutting board.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I think we have just enough ingredients for Harold's Spicy Soup! It was his favorite!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Why doesn't your maid just cook for you?
Grandma Betty chuckles.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: A maid?! How rich! There are no maids or servants here, dear. We do `all` the work ourselves.
nodes.text_bbcode: A maid?! How rich! There are no maids or servants here, dear. We do [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the work ourselves.

nodes.text: Paige is holding the knife like it's a dead mouse.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: For goodness' sake! Owie, help her!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure, Grandma.
Owen moves next to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owie?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, that's my Owen's nickname. When he was a little baby, he couldn't say his own name... All he could say was 'Owie'!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma, we don't have to talk about when I was a baby. Like, at all.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: He loved running around the house at top speed with his bare bottom out for all the world to see!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's something I'll definitely include in the presentation.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about you just focus on these scallions?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what? How about you do it? You probably know more about manual labor than I do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're not getting out of this...

options.label: You have to do what I do.

nodes.text: Paige bursts into laughter!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Weightlifting must cause brain damage because that's the dumbest thing you've ever said!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You were just going to say that I'm a good guy. Tell me I'm wrong!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're wrong!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What I was going to say was this...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's bad enough $ZOE has one good guy going after her, let alone two `and` a complete nobody!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's bad enough $ZOE has one good guy going after her, let alone two [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] a complete nobody!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you forget that Nate Crawford's interested in her? At least he's actually `someone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you forget that Nate Crawford's interested in her? At least he's actually [color=#3b78e2][i]someone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: His dad's the mayor, and I'm `sure` his family's wealthy.
nodes.text_bbcode: His dad's the mayor, and I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] his family's wealthy.

nodes.text: Owen's face turns red.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe you actually thought `I` liked `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you actually thought [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] liked [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That might not be true, but...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: First me and Nate, now Howard! There are three guys interested in her, and that totally bothers you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Plus everyone's making a big deal about how Howard and $ZOE are back together... Kind of burst your popularity bubble, didn't it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Argh! Yes, you're right! Just shut up about it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's always $ZOE $ZOE $ZOE! Oh, look at me, I'm $ZOE, I made a cupcake shaped like a sheep!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft. Big whoop. I actually own a sheep!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's... Kind of weird.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, let's stop talking about Perfect Princess, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine by me, but...
Owen brings the weight down... But he can't lift it back up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Help!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Help![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing? Aren't you supposed to be `lifting` the weight? It looks like you're just holding it against your neck...
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing? Aren't you supposed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]lifting[/i][/color] the weight? It looks like you're just holding it against your neck...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Help!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Help![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jacob runs over and lifts the weight off of Owen.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Dude, trying to impress a girl doesn't automatically make you stronger!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought I could lift it...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No girl's worth a broken neck!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't know how much I'm worth!
Jacob walks away laughing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Awww... Is he right? Were you trying to impress me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'd rather not talk about it.
Owen takes a couple of deep breaths... And lifts the barbell off the support!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't think I can lift more? Fine. I'll prove you wrong.
Owen gets back up, pulls more weights off the rack, and sets them on the barbell.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Satisfied?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, I can't believe you fell for that. What do I know about weights?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Owen's whipped!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I know. And he does whatever she says too!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's what 'whipped' means, dummy.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh.
Owen sits up off the bench and looks at Jacob and Zach.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Could either of you lift this much?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh, well, I'm really sore.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I have a bad back from... Studying so much.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's what I thought.
He turns back to Paige.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice try. This is a good amount of weight.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aww... No fun.
In the weight room... Owen carries weights from a rack and sets them on a barbell for bench pressing.
As he gets into position under the barbell, Paige hovers over him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you actually planning to spot me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I was just wondering if you were only planning to lift this much... Is it like a warm-up for when you lift more later?
Nearby, several of the guys from the football team snicker.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. Don't let him fool you! That's the most he's ever lifted!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, but isn't the point of this assignment for you to actually learn something about me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Easy there, Caveman. I think I already know enough.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know that I eat in the cafeteria and that I lift weights in the weight room. Not what Mr. Dean had in mind.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I know a lot more than that. I know you're afraid of what I'm going to think of you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Afraid? Pfft. I'm not--
Paige gives him an 'Oh really?' look.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay... Maybe I care what you think `a little.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... Maybe I care what you think [color=#e23b3b][i]a little.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I know why you rushed me out of that cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You were being really mean to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on! $ZOE can hold her own against a mean girl. You rushed me out of there because you're jealous of Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? That's not--
Paige gives Owen the same look.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, you got me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Psych class is `way` easy. If I don't get an 'A' on this, something is totally wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. Psych class is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] easy. If I don't get an 'A' on this, something is totally wrong.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, I guess you were right. You do already know me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, that's not completely true. There's still one thing I don't understand at all.
Owen towels off the bench.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why `$ZOE?` I mean, could she `be` any more boring and drab? She's completely thrift.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE?[/i][/color] I mean, could she [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] any more boring and drab? She's completely thrift.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thrift?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Have you seen her clothes? They don't even come from a designer line I've heard of.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not something I care about... Or any guy for that matter.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Look, all I'm saying is that $ZOE's been head over hand-me-down heels for Howard since forever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A guy like you can't compete. Maybe if you had money...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why do you care?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't. I just hate $ZOE. It's bad enough having one good guy go after her, let alone...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aha! I see what's going on here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

options.label: You have a crush on me!
You're jealous of all the attention $ZOE's getting!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whatever... It doesn't matter! If it ends in 'day', I'm happy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't argue with that. So, where `is` $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't argue with that. So, where [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where do you think? She's probably off spit-swapping with Mr. Perfect right now...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Their faces all mashed up against each other like a couple of manatees.
Owen, thinking about $ZOE and Howard together, feels a rush of jealousy!
He steps outside, rounds the corner behind the school for a breather...
And bumps right into $ZOE and Howard mid-makeout session!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!
$ZOE separates from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Awkward!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see `you` there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't seen you much at all since the fundraiser...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Been real busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool.
Owen kicks at a piece of trash on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So...

options.label: How's the Social Chair thing going?

nodes.text: After Owen and Paige get her some food, they sit back down at the Center Table.
Paige takes in her surroundings, noticing $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Interesting! $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hi, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Listen, when you have time, could you advise me on whether my food purchases were economical today?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, wait, never mind. You're not very good at `budgets` are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, wait, never mind. You're not very good at [color=#3b78e2][i]budgets[/i][/color] are you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's it like...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Where's `my` food?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Where's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] food?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You have to get it yourself. That's how cafeterias work.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no. I'm not doing that. Go get it for me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm not your servant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Forget it. I just wanted some courtesy!
Owen sneaks a glance at Spencer and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ahem. Not important. Cough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kindness!
In the weight room... Owen carries weights from a rack and sets them on a barbell for bench pressing.
As he gets into position under the barbell, Paige hovers over him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you actually planning to spot me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I was just wondering if you were only planning to lift this much... Is it like a warm-up for when you lift more later?
Nearby, several of the guys from the football team snicker.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. Don't let him fool you! That's the most he's ever lifted!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, he really is.
Owen walks back into the school...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE didn't seem... Happy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But what do I know? She and Howard have so much great history. He must be good for her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At least, better for her than me...
In Psychology class, Mr. Dean is explaining the class's first big project when Owen comes in late.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: We were just pairing up with the partners I assigned last week. I believe you and Paige are together.
Owen sits in the open seat next to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Don't be late again.
Paige smiles broadly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: As I was saying, this assignment is designed to get you to delve deep into the psyche of your partner.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: You will spend one day observing and, to some extent, participating in the life of your partner.
Paige leans over, whispering...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tsk tsk, five minutes late. What happened? Did the poor kid bus run out of gas again?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know. Does riding that `high-horse` all day give you butt pain?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know. Does riding that [color=#e23b3b][i]high-horse[/i][/color] all day give you butt pain?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: You will witness a typical day in their lives, and then next week they will witness yours.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: At the end of the assignment, you will each give a presentation on what you've observed about your partner. The point of the assignment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know why you're late. It wasn't the bus, was it? You were off in the bathroom crying because you learned about Howard and $ZOE, weren't you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You got me. I was in the bathroom, all right. You know, your name appears on the walls in a bunch of different places... You make out with a lot of guys!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, is that right? And why'd you notice? Are you secretly into me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Into `you?!` Seriously? You've got to be kidding--
nodes.text_bbcode: Into [color=#e23b3b][i]you?![/i][/color] Seriously? You've got to be kidding--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: The point, ladies and gentlemen, is to be surprised. To learn something unexpected. After all, things aren't always as they seem.
Mr. Dean claps his hands together.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Also, your score is fifteen percent of your grade!
The students groan!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean

That weekend, Emily and Ben are having lunch together...
So then Hector tells Miss Fitzpootie that the best way to make money is to throw the best party ever!
And what'd she say?
She said, 'There's always a better party.'
You should have seen the look on his face! It totally blew his mind!  It was like this...
Hee hee! That totally reminds me of this story that Cameron was telling me about at practice this week!
He--
Uh, hey, do you want a refill? I'm gonna get some more soda.
Oh, no thanks.
Ben gets up and refills his drink. When he sits back down...
So, how's Kimi doing?
Wait... I didn't get to tell you Cameron's story!
Oh, yeah. Right. Cameron.
So... We were just treading water together, and Cameron's talking about...
Hey, sorry to interrupt, but, um, what do you think of Miss Prez?
Alicia?
Sorry! Yes, Alicia.  I didn't know you were on a first name basis!
Yeah, well, once you mistake a teacher for a student, you enter into some really weird territory!
She seems cool.
I like her. I'm just glad I have her for homeroom and not for History. I heard she can be really tough!
But, wait, stop distracting me! I'm trying to tell you this story Cameron told me.
A look crosses Ben's face.
What?
I'm sorry, Em... I know you said you and Cameron are just friends and that nothing really happened on the trip, but...
I still feel jealous.
There's nothing for you to be jealous of!
I know. I hear that, but it doesn't change how I feel.
So... What do you want me to do?
I'm not going to ask you to stop talking to him. The last thing I want to be is `that` guy.
No, that guy sucks.
But can we just not talk about him?
Your answer for dealing with feelings of jealousy is to stop talking about the guy you're jealous of?
Pretty much. Yup. Out of sight, out of mind.
Only in this case, out of ear, out of mind...
And yeah, I know that came out weird, but I'm sticking to it.
Well... Okay, if that's what you want, I guess I'll stop talking about him.
That's what I want.
Now, about Kimi... How is she?
Um...
Emily tries to concentrate on talking about Kimi, but her mind dwells on what just transpired.
It feels weird that there's this whole part of my life I can't talk to Ben about now...

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
